{{Quote|I am a stormtrooper. My skin is my armor. My face is my helmet. My name is my number. I am fulfilled, for I am an agent of the Emperor.|Stormtrooper pledge|<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Stormtrooper Corps''' was an independent [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] branch that operated alongside the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was the smallest of the primary three branches of the military. Though they functioned under their own [[Stormtrooper Command/Legends|command structure]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]] ultimately answered directly to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the architects and sovereigns of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] that incorporated most of the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] under Imperial rule. Regarded as elite [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] and the [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] of the Empire, the [[Corps/Legends|Corps]] also functioned as the Emperor's primary enforcers&mdash;both within the military ranks and the galactic populace alike&mdash;due to their uncompromising allegiance to Palpatine.

The first stormtroopers were the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that the following regime inherited after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, the Stormtrooper Corps gradually expanded its ranks to include [[Clone stormtrooper|cloned soldiers]] from different [[DNA/Legends|genetic sources]]. Further changes in policy led to the recruitment of birth-born [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as enlisted [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. Before long, the original [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] [[Clone template/Legends|line]] were reduced to the status of a minority within the [[Army/Legends|army]] that they once held as their [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|exclusive province]]. Although its direct predecessor was the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, the Stormtrooper [[TX-5532]] implied that they may have been comparable to the [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit]] in terms of an elite, first-attack unit of soldiers in galactic history.

Although their ranks were numerous and well-armed with advanced [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|weaponry]] and [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]], stormtroopers were generally less respected as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] by the clone troopers who preceded them. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], one of the last clones who remained in service [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the Empire, believed that the operational effectiveness of the Stormtrooper Corps had been severely diminished over time, a setback that he blamed on the infusion of Human recruits into the stormtrooper ranks.

At some point by the [[Fel Empire]], the Stormtrooper Corps was disbanded and the stormtroopers were redistributed into the Imperial Army. Individual stormtrooper units still continued to operate separately as elite shock forces, with [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]] being allowed to serve in their ranks.

==Role==
{{Quote|Stormtroopers are the knife's edge. We are the first to go in. We face the enemy where they are strongest. We do not stop until we have achieved our objective. The Imperial Army walks in the path we blaze.|[[TX-5532]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IHB" />}}
[[File:Stormtrooper_CEII1.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Stormtroopers served as guards for high-ranking Imperial officials.]]
An independent branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the Stormtrooper Corps supported both the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] while belonging to neither. Existing as an elite, fanatically-loyal force of [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]], the Stormtrooper Corps existed to impose the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] will on the military and the galactic populace alike.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> Their loyalty to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was such that, although they were perfectly willing to die for the Empire if needs be, they lacked suicidal thoughts, as they realized that a dead stormtrooper would be useless to the Empire unless it was to further the Emperor's wishes, and were also purported to lack fear to such an extent that they don't surrender unless facing impossible odds, and even then only after securing the primary objective.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> Although their primary loyalty was to the Emperor, and then to the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]],<ref name="sweSTO">{{SWE|groups|stormtroopers|Stormtroopers}}</ref> they also served as honor guards for upper-level Imperial personnel such as [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassadors]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moffs]], [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]], and/or [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-Generals]], with such units being composed of at least 10 stormtroopers.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd" />

When serving with the Navy, Stormtroopers served as [[Imperial Marines/Legends|Marines]] and ensured loyalty aboard ships, as well as acting as security forces on both ships and battle stations as well as securing various enemy ships for capture. On the ground, they led assaults, advancing ahead of Army units to take strategic targets like [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and gun emplacements, and were deployed to the toughest fighting. A rapid deployment force rather than one for occupation, the Stormtrooper Corps was almost entirely [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]]-based and was far smaller in number than either the Army or Navy. Largely because of their serving both military branches depending on the situation, the Corps were far more flexible regarding ground and space operations than their Army counterparts.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd" /> The Corps maintained its own command structure and training regimens and generally relied on its own infrastructure for support. The Stormtroopers were the best-known Imperial soldiers, and one of the most iconic symbols of the Empire's military might.<ref name="IHB" /><ref name="EG Warfare" /> The Corps' reputation was such that even their very presence is enough to act as an effective deterrent against any and all groups save for the most motivated of saboteurs and aggressors.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd" />

Because of their role as the Emperor's chief enforcers and shock troops, and thus, their being deployed when the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] required their service and being recalled when needed elsewhere, the Stormtrooper Corps was unconcerned with long-term occupation of a planet, gaining extraction only when securing a withdrawal point. The only exception to this rule is when prolonged struggles threaten the Empire's industrial capacity and/or weaken its strategic positions.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd" /> Also because of this, the Stormtrooper Corps was streamlined and ready for rapid deployment, operating on every planet in the Empire. They also had little concern about having fewer members than the assembled ranks of both the Imperial Army and Navy, with [[TX-5532]] stating that this is just as it should be, comparing it to how a narrow blade is much sharper than a thick blade.<ref name="IHB" /> As such, they can also be deployed in large numbers if a quick victory was essential and/or heavy opposition was expected. However, they are rarely deployed to worlds that have no strategic value to the Empire, and are generally deployed to planets that the Empire deems important enough to function as forward bases, places to harvest natural resources, and/or industrial capacity-related roles.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Stormtrooper Corps is unparalleled. Do not compare us to the feeble Judicial Security forces that existed in the dying decades of the Old Republic. You must look back nearly four thousand years to the time of Republic rocket-jumpers to find an equivalent corps of elite, first-attack soldiers.|[[TX-5532]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IHB" />}}
===The New Order===
{{Quote|Armed with deadly new weapons, blazing new ships, and shiny new armor, our presence let the galaxy know that the days of the Old Republic were well and truly over.|[[Retired clone trooper]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
[[File:First_stromtroopers_EGT_Warfare.png|thumb|left|230px|Clone troopers swap their Phase II armor for the new stormtrooper design in the early years of the New Order.]]
The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] [[Corps/Legends|Corps]] was formed in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] at the same time as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]], came to an end. In [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|historic speech]] addressed to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] and citizenry of the Republic, the old political establishment was reformed into the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]; a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the rule of the self-appointed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine.<ref name="Episode III" /> The same speech detailed a number of reforms that emphasized the policy of [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]], including the renaming of all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] as Imperial stormtroopers.<ref name="HoloNet News">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> Hence, the [[Clone stormtrooper|first stormtroopers]] were all [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the [[Clone template/Legends|template]] of the Republic [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]].<ref name="EG Warfare" />

Throughout the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of Emperor Palpatine, various reforms to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] steadily diminished the Empire's reliance on clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Such changes were also intended to further distance the Empire's image from its past as the old Republic. Even before the introduction of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], the Empire's preference for uniformity and obedience brought an end to the Grand Army's tradition of unit markings and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] customization and thus restored the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II battle armor]] to a blank [[Color/Legends|white]] appearance. The clone trooper's [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] was deemed obsolete in favor of the stormtrooper's [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. The clones' use of nicknames, which they had developed under the encouragement of their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi officers]], fell out of style as [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] referred to them by number designations. Whereas the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had taken a keen interest in fostering individuality and creativity within the clone troopers, the Stormtrooper Corps instilled the clones with the doctrine of absolute loyalty and conformity to the New Order.<ref name="EG Warfare" />

Stormtroopers were an integral part to Emperor Palpatine's efforts to consolidate the fledgling Empire. Revolts were spread across the galaxy, ranging from the Emperor's [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The Stormtrooper Corps not only contended with various planetary insurrections, but also the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|scattered remnants]] of the former Separatist Alliance. [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency directive]] that instructed all clone troopers to summarily execute their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] superiors, also remained in effect throughout the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], thus requiring the stormtroopers to kill any Jedi on sight and even participate in hunts for the most prominent among these rabble-rousers,<ref name="Battlefront II" /> often under the supervision of the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]],<ref name="kenner" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

[[File:Kashyyyk_Troopers_Vader_TFU.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Stormtroopers in an early form of their armor support Darth Vader early in the Imperial Era.]]
The introduction of new clone lines<ref name="Battlefront II" /> and [[Human/Legends|Human]] recruits<ref name="TFUII Databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref> to the stormtrooper ranks was the direct result of a new policy influenced by the highly classified [[Kaminoan resistance|Kaminoan Uprising]], a clone rebellion on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] where the original clone troopers were conceived.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> Until then, most stormtroopers still consisted of the same [[DNA/Legends|genetic makeup]], the modified template of Jango Fett.<ref name="Battlefront II" /> One exception was the experimental [[GeNode]] clone line, composed of clones created from several different templates. The GeNodes proved unreliable, however, and were prone to cases of [[clone madness]]. By and large, clone stormtroopers were bred from the same gene pool, grown and trained through [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] and [[Arkanian Microtechnologies|Arkanian Micro]] methods.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> When the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] created their own secret [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Anti-trooper|renegade clone troopers]], the Emperor deemed the Fett line to be compromised. The [[Kamino uprising|insurrection]] was thwarted and the Empire regained control of Kamino's [[Tipoca City/Legends|cloning facilities]], but the Stormtrooper Corps became increasingly diverse with an influx of clones from a variety of templates.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

===The end of the clone troopers===
{{Quote|Since the Empire has redirected the clone trooper program to other pursuits and stepped up recruiting inferior humans from the Outer Rim, the operational effectiveness of this army has declined significantly.|Commander Cody|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Recruiting_poster_Empire_EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A recruiting poster for the Corps]]
Clones remained an essential factor to the Stormtrooper Corps, but their importance continued to diminish over time<ref name="EG Warfare" /> as the ranks became increasingly filled with enlisted [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]; birth-born Humans recruited to serve the Empire as Imperial stormtroopers.<ref name="TFUII Databank" /> Both numerous throughout the galaxy and the [[High Human Culture/Legends|dominant]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the Empire, Humans were regarded as the solution to the dilemma of cloning. [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|processes]] created subpar troopers, and the Kaminoan method was considered too slow and expensive.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> From the perspective of the Fett clones, the Stormtrooper Corps had lost the purity that defined the old Clone Army of the Republic. The few remaining clones of the Fett line, such as a [[Retired clone trooper|veteran]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]<ref name="Battlefront II" /> and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]],<ref name="TFUII Databank" /> regarded the new clones and enlisted personnel as unwelcome outsiders.<ref name="Battlefront II" /> Cody especially loathed Human recruits, deeming them to be inferior to clone troopers and the reason behind the significant decrease in the operational effectiveness of the Stormtrooper Corps.<ref name="TFUII Databank" /> Throughout the decade before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the percentage of clone soldiers had been reduced to roughly a third of the overall Stormtrooper Corps.<ref name="EG Warfare" />

When the once all-clone Stormtrooper Corps opened its ranks to Human recruits, the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] System was utilized for stormtrooper training. Most enlisted troopers graduated from the [[Academy|academies]] on [[Corulag Academy|Corulag]] and [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal]], but the most exceptional stormtrooper [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] were assigned to the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. During the Clone Wars, [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] was a training center for non-clone [[Republic officer/Legends|officers]] who led clone [[Division/Legends|divisions]], and continued to do so with the Stormtrooper Corps. Under the Empire, Carida gained a reputation for producing the best and bravest cadets. Clones bred with greater independence were also stationed at Carida where they developed their leadership skills with a combination of [[Flash training|flash instruction]] and live training.<ref name="EG Warfare" />

[[File:Stormtrooper_alt_card_art_IACS.png|thumb|right|250px|Stormtroopers under fire in an urban city.]]
Stormtrooper training consisted of two years of grueling exercises&mdash;both physically and mentally&mdash;that produced elite soldiers, heavily indoctrinated in the tenets of the New Order. Their deep commitment to Emperor Palpatine,<ref name="EG Warfare" /> coupled with their personal loyalty to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader,<ref name="sweSTO2">{{SWE|groups|stormtroopers|Stormtroopers}}</ref> were well-known throughout the Empire; few stormtroopers could be bribed, blackmailed, or seduced into renouncing their allegiance to the Galactic Empire.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> In large part because of Imperial NewsNets reporting on the Empire's various victories against the forces of Rebellion and chaos, the Stormtrooper Corps proved to be a very popular choice of profession among Imperial citizenry when asked how they were to serve the regime.<ref name="IHB" />

===The Battle of Endor and legacy===
[[File:VictoryOnEndor.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The Battle of Endor marked the start of the end for the Stormtrooper Corps.]]
The [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> not only marked a turning point in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but also a sharp and steady [[Imperial Civil War|decline]] for the Galactic Empire.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> While both Emperor Palpatine and Lord Vader perished aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] during the space battle above [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the stormtroopers suffered a devastating defeat against a [[Endor strike team/Legends|Rebel strike team]] and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], a primitive race indigenous to the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> Due to the sudden vacuum of power created by the loss of the two reigning [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], the leaderless Empire fractured into numerous factions, fragmenting the Stormtrooper Corps between various [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] and claimants to the Imperial throne, leading to its collapse, with stormtroopers placed directly into the Imperial Army.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> In some factions' cases, they even blended the stormtroopers and Imperial Army together by supplying Imperial Army troopers with stormtrooper armor due to the decrease of cloning facilities and academies, while in Zsinj's faction's case, they were largely replaced in terms of function with the Raptors.

In the decades after the Galactic Civil War concluded with victory for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Stormtrooper Corps was restored, although in a heavily reduced state, mirroring the Empire's devolution into the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and but after its transition into the [[Fel Empire]], the corps was disbanded and were made part of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] once more. In [[137 ABY]], a [[Second Imperial Civil War|new civil war]] divided the resurgent Empire once more, forcing the stormtroopers to fight amongst themselves in the conflict between [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] and [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile|loyalist faction]].<ref name="EG Warfare" />

==Organization and structure==
===Administration===
[[File:Intimitated_-TCG_by_Zach_Graves.png|thumb|right|260px|Stormtroopers often served directly under the command of Lord Vader.]]
Prior to the Battle of Endor and the de facto collapse of Imperial authority, the highest organizational body of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] was the [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]]. Below this was [[Stormtrooper Command/Legends|Stormtrooper Command]], the organizing body that directed all operations of the Stormtrooper Corps. Stormtrooper Command took orders directly from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="IHB" /> although some individual units, referred to as [[Moff's Own]], were often at the disposal of a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. In addition, Stormtroopers often served under the command of the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]]<ref name="kenner" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="Five Days of Sith 2">[[Star Wars (2013) 14|''Star Wars'' (2013) 14]]</ref><ref name="ESB2">{{Film|V}}</ref> who held direct control over his elite personal [[Legion/Legends|legion]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> In addition, Stormtrooper Command members were held to a high standard: any that were ruled as incompetent were sentenced to either execution, or otherwise being forced to serve the Corps in the field.

===Personnel===
{{Quote|The Empire has a legion of loyal soldiers that are in endless supply.|Darth Vader|<ref name="Empire: Betrayal">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Betrayal]]''</ref>}}
[[File:StormtroopersMarch-Empire16.png|thumb|left|300px|Stormtroopers march as a uniform bloc under the watchful gaze of an Imperial officer.]]
The Stormtrooper Corps, pre-Imperial Remnant, was made up largely of Humans, and primarily of males, with very few females becoming stormtroopers. According to one female stormtrooper, [[Isila Drutch]], the reason behind the comparatively small amount of females in the Corps had more to do with practicality rather than outright prejudice, as the stormtrooper physical training regimen was brutal enough that females were simply more likely to wash out than males due to their physiology, as well as there being no female clone lines. She also implied that the stormtrooper armor's design was such that it was impossible for civilians to know the gender underneath and thus it was assumed there were no females in the Stormtrooper Corps.<ref name="EG Warfare" />

Aliens were generally not allowed to join the Stormtrooper Corps during the New Order, the only exception being the [[T'Syriél]] stormtroopers, due to the officer who recruited them, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]], being an alien himself, specifically belonging to the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]],<ref name="Star Wars 1977 54">[[Star Wars (1977) 54|''Star Wars'' (1977) 54]]</ref> and possibly [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stafuv Rahz]], a [[Gektl]], due to his wearing a similar uniform to that of NCO Stormtrooper Corps officers.<ref name="Bring Me the Children">"[[Bring Me the Children]]"</ref> After the Empire was reduced to the Imperial Remnant, the Stormtrooper Corps started recruiting more females and also started recruiting aliens into its ranks, mostly as desperation in trying to fight off the New Republic. The Stormtrooper Corps belonging to the [[Empire of the Hand]] faction also incorporated aliens among its ranks,<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> and the [[United Warlord Fleets]] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] had a small corps of stormtroopers that were composed entirely of aliens.<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

===Tactical organization===
{{Quote|Despite outside appearances, there is a complex and varied hierarchy within the stormtrooper ranks. I thought I understood it all. But to even access the dossiers on this team, I had to be cleared for a security level far above my rank.|Ensign [[Nanda (ensign)|Nanda]]|<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (2013) 13|''Star Wars'' (2013) 13]]</ref>}}
[[File:Snowtrooper_Captain.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Cold assault stormtrooper|Snowtroopers]] of the Stormtrooper Corps specialized in cold-weather operations.]]
The Stormtrooper Corps was organized under the [[Order of Battle/Legends|Order of Battle]]. This mirrored the Imperial Army's lower-level structure, but unlike the Army, the [[Legion/Legends|legion]] was the highest level in the Stormtroopers' command structure. In addition, stormtrooper units did not include support personnel.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> Despite this, however, the Stormtroopers had no issue with gaining enough supplies to maintain the overall sizeable amount within the Corps in addition to siphoning off at least some supplies from the normal chain of logistics. How they were able to do so is unclear, with it being debated that they merely "lived off the land," had access to a shadow network to enhance their mystery, or simply did not even need a resupply in the first place.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd" /> From the outside, the Stormtrooper Corps appeared to have a simple structure, but insiders would discover the hierarchy and separations between forces were complex and varied.<ref name="SW13" />

*'''[[Legion/Legends|Legion]]'''&mdash;9,813 units: 4 regiments (9,812 units: 8,192 troopers and 1,620 officers) led by a [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonel]].<ref name="EG Warfare" /> The largest defined level of organization within the Stormtrooper Corps, it is the approximate equivalent to an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Battle group|battlegroup]]. Depending on the specific size of the squads and legions composing it, a legion can even reach as high as 14,677 units, composed of 12,800 troopers and 1,876 officers.<ref name="IHB" /> The legions mere deployment and parading also act as a form of psychological warfare, being adept at manipulating the psychology of dominance while shielded in the eerie anonymity of their armor.<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
*'''[[Regiment/Legends|Regiment]]'''&mdash;2,453 units: 4 battalions (2,452 units: 2,048 troopers and 404 officers) led by a [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]].<ref name="EG Warfare" /> A Stormtrooper regiment is considered sufficient enough to seize a Class A planetary starport. Depending on the size of the scouts and platoons, it may reach as high as 3,669 units, composed of 3,200 troopers and 468 officers.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]]'''&mdash;613 units: 4 companies (612 units: 512 troopers and 100 officers) led by a [[Major/Legends|major]].<ref name="EG Warfare" /> A Battalion is very likely to incorporate many types of specialized stormtrooper units, including scout troopers and incinerator stormtroopers. Depending on the amount of squad and platoon manpower, the units may reach as high as 917 units; specifically 800 troopers and 116 officers.<ref name="IHB" /> In some cases, however, they also lacked of staff officers, which have them holding 820 men similar to that of battalions within the standard [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd" />
*'''[[Company/Legends|Company]]'''&mdash;153 units: 4 platoons: 112 troopers, 16 corporals, 16 sergeants, 4 sergeant-majors, and 4 lieutenants, led by a [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="EG Warfare" />
*'''[[Platoon/Legends|Platoon]]'''&mdash;38 units: 4 squads: 28 troopers, 4 corporals, and 4 sergeants, led by 1 [[Sergeant major/Legends|sergeant major]] and 1 [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="EG Warfare" />
*'''[[Squad/Legends|Squad]]'''&mdash;9 units: 8 troopers, including a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]], led by a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]].<ref name="EG Warfare" /> It was the smallest stormtrooper unit typically deployed into a threat situation; it could also include up to 10 troopers.<ref name="IHB" />

Although a Legion was the highest possible standard unit within the Stormtrooper Corps, various legions had been known to merge from other sectors into one unit within a Sector Group for a major offensive.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook 2nd" /> Similarly, even though the squad was the lowest possible standard unit within the Stormtrooper Corps, the squad itself could be further subdivided into two [[Fire team/Legends|Fire Teams]], each being in a wedge formation, with the fire team leaders being at the tip of each wedge, in order to allow for maximum firing range every direction and allow for ready communications between members.<ref name="IHB" /> One formation of [[Elite stormtrooper (Galactic Empire)|elite stormtroopers]] operated far outside the typical structure of the Imperial machine.<ref name="SW13" />

==Personnel==
{{Quote|[&hellip;] many seek to wear the polished white armor of the Stormtrooper Corps. Only a few succeed. Most fail to meet the posted physical requirements. Others wash out during training. Passing the merciless standards of the Stormtrooper Corps is a point of honor for those within our ranks, but the Imperial Army and Navy need recruits too.|[[TX-5532]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="IHB" />}}
===Specializations===
Upon the implementation of a program to recruit from the Imperial citizenry as opposed to relying solely on clones, facilities for the training of new Stormtrooper recruits were implemented. New recruitment policies compensated for the lack of uniformity among non-clone cadets by adopting strict standards of conformity to maintain the integrity of the Corps. The requirements for the Stormtrooper Corps, at least by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], required that the recruit have a genetic suitability in comparison to the Human clone template of 97.5% or higher, be between 1.79-1.85 meters in height, a weight of 78-85 kg, a Scala body mass/musculature rating of 22.x5 or less, a Marrev tactical intelligence rating of 790 or higher, and a Minimum Class C in Receptivity to Indoctrination.<ref name="IHB" />

By seeking optimal morphologic consistency with the previous cloning standards, the Empire saved money by being able to produce interchangeable uniforms and armor.<ref name="IHB" /> At the height of the Empire, the Corps was almost exclusively Human but for a few experimental units, and overwhelmingly male since very few females could pass physical training, though female Stormtroopers were more common than most laymen realised.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> Shielded in the eerie anonymity of their [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|white armor]], Stormtroopers were trained to think of themselves as expendable and to ignore casualties within their own ranks beyond a tactical standpoint<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /><ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary" /> in order to achieve the objective.<ref name="IHB" /> Extensive indoctrination also produced unswerving loyalty to the Empire: throughout the entire Galactic Civil War, very few attempts to bribe, blackmail or seduce a Stormtrooper succeeded.<ref name="EG Warfare" />

The Stormtrooper Corps had a variety of stormtrooper specializations, each one trained in a specific role for enforcing the Emperor's Will and directly confronting any threats to the Empire. Specialized stormtroopers were selected for training in the field at an early stage and then conditioned with the appropriate knowledge and psychological training for the field in question. Upon being specialized, their psychological conditioning to their particular identity was rendered strong enough that the trooper almost never wished to change his division.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /><ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary" /> As such, the various Stormtroopers, via a combination of exceptional training and extraordinary armor, also possessed various specialized units to tackle any environment in the galaxy, up to and including various worlds that harbor climates that are hostile to humans.<ref name="IHB" />

*'''[[Aquatic assault stormtrooper]]'''&mdash; Also known as "Seatroopers", they were deployed to oceanic worlds to pacify threats beneath the waves. Their armor was resistant to crushing ocean depths, and its air supply lasted for over an hour. They also sported flippered boots and a backpack propulsion unit for aiding in underwater mobility, and were armed with a modified E-11 blaster rifle that doubled as a speargun.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Bomb squad stormtrooper]]'''&mdash; Also known as "Bombtroopers", they were trained to disarm explosive devices, varying from anti-tank mines to primitive spring traps, as well as to recover the device intact for Imperial Intelligence, making them more valuable than bomb-disposal droids. They possessed specialized armor that could withstand controlled explosions and high-velocity shrapnel, and a helmet fitted with sensors for detecting chemical signatures of explosives and an automatic full muffling mode to protect the eyes and ears of the wearer at the first sign of an explosion.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Crowd Control Stormtrooper]]'''&mdash;Crowd Control Stormtroopers, similar to riot stormtroopers, were often dispatched to areas with high crime rates. Unlike the riot stormtrooper, however, they largely relied on various anti-riot materials from afar and had equipment relating to this goal.<ref name="Power of the Force CCS">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Crowd Control Stormtrooper|link=POTF2dlxstorm.asp}}</ref>
*'''[[EVO trooper]]'''&mdash; EVO troopers were stormtroopers that were specifically trained to operate in various extreme environments, such as extreme heat, acid rivers, and places constantly being struck by lightning. As such, they underwent extreme training, and were generally recruited among those who had significant anti-alien sentiments. They were identified by their wearing heavy enhanced armor with breathing tubes.<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
*'''[[Field stormtrooper]]'''&mdash; were high-ranking stormtroopers with superior battlefield experience and weaponry.
*'''[[Stormtrooper grenadier/Legends|Grenadier trooper]]'''&mdash; Grenadier troopers were stormtroopers who often acted as [[Grenadier/Legends|grenadiers]]. Several wore a similar uniform to the cold assault stormtroopers, albeit equipped with an armored hand shield and plasma grenades.
*'''[[Hazard stormtrooper]]'''&mdash; Hazard troopers were trained and deployed to worlds with extreme planetary climates and conditions, often wearing armor that fully sealed them from acidic, electromagnetic, biochemical, and other environmental threats. Because the extreme conditions for the job, Stormtroopers selected for hazard duty undergo cyborg limb replacement to supply the strength and stamina needed to operate the armor for extended missions.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Imperial Heavy Trooper/Legends|Heavy stormtrooper]]'''&mdash; Heavy troopers wore a specialized type of stormtrooper armor and were trained for frontline combat against incredibly powerful enemies such as [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], and other large aliens. Due to their role in melee-based combat, these troopers made use of large electro staffs against their enemies.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*'[[Imperial Marines/Legends|''Imperial Marine''']]&mdash; Assigned to the Imperial Navy, the Imperial Marines were stationed on Star Destroyers and other naval warships, serving as the first wave boarding party on captured starships. They were also trained to repel hostiles if a ship's defense is breached.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|Incinerator stormtrooper]]'''&mdash; Incinerator troopers were identified with red markings on their armor to indicate their specialty and were trained for laying down flame and reactive chemicals. They were equipped with [[Oppressor flamethrower]]s and [[Plasma rifle/Legends|plasma rifles]] with wide-stream spreads capable of exciting molecules to the burning point, though they had at one point completed a mission only with thermobaric canisters and mortar launchers. They were most frequently used against enemy infantry and to purge local villages.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Magma stormtrooper]]'''&mdash; Magma troopers, also known as "Lavatroopers", were stormtroopers specifically trained to operate in active geologic vents. They were often stationed to volcanic mines containing rare ores that are threatened by the Rebel Alliance. They were supplied with equipment directly relating to volcanic activity, including Duravlex-reinforced armor capable of withstanding extreme temperatures up to 1,900 degrees centigrade.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Minetrooper]]'''&mdash;Also known as "Imperial tunneling underminers", the minetroopers are stormtroopers that were specifically trained to operate within the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-laden atmosphere of [[Sevarcos II]] mine quarries. As such, their armor, which was given a tanned color, was also designed to take into account the mine's spice-laden atmosphere, such as the bodysuit being thicker than usual to seal the wearer and thus protect them from the noxious spice gases. Their primary duty was guarding the mining equipment, although they also can be called in to stop rampaging [[spice eel]]s and/or suppressing revolting prisoners in the mines.<ref name="Adventure Journal 2">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref>
*'''[[Radiation zone assault trooper]]'''&mdash; Also known as "radtroopers", they were deployed to heavy radiation zones, namely those that are strategically valuable planets or battlegrounds that were rendered inhospitable due to the detonation of fission weapons. Because of this, their armor, powered by a backpack unit, was coated with silver and lined with a lead-polymer that blocked electromagnetic energy as well as guarding its wearer from outside contaminants, and also contained handheld sensors as standard equipment to determine any potential risks for any slaves that might be assigned to work in the area.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Riot stormtrooper/Legends|Riot stormtrooper]]'''&mdash; Riot troopers were stormtroopers created specifically to deal with civil unrest in various worlds to reestablish Imperial Order. Because of the important need for personal combat, they were trained at the Yinchorr academy alongside the Emperor's Royal Guard.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Stormsurgeon]]'''&mdash; Stormsurgeons, as implied by the name, were [[Medic/Legends|medics]] within the Stormtrooper Corps trained to undergo dangerous medical operations on the field or within direct combat. They are identifiable with bronze pauldrons.<ref name="SW Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
*'''[[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|Sandtrooper]]'''&mdash;Desert Stormtroopers, better known as Sandtroopers, were stationed on desert worlds, with their armor being designed specifically for use on these worlds, such as SD-48 survival backpacks.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout trooper]]'''&mdash;Scout troopers, also known as biker scouts, were often used in recon-related missions including leading patrols to determine the strength of enemy forces and/or perform hit-and-fade attacks in support of a larger ground force. As such, they were experts in mobile reconnaissance, trained infiltrators, and survivalists.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Jumptrooper/Legends|Skytrooper]]/Jumptrooper'''&mdash;Skytroopers and Jumptroopers were experts at air to ground attacks, being equipped with [[Hush-About AJP-400]]s that they used to reconnoiter battlefields, reach inaccessible areas, land undetected behind enemy lines, or gain elevation to fire on enemies.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Cold assault stormtrooper|Snowtrooper]]'''&mdash;Cold Assault Stormtroopers, better known as Snowtroopers, were trained for operation in arctic environments.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Speeder Bike Assault Force]]'''&mdash;A Stormtrooper variant that utilized [[Speeder bike/Legends|specialized Speeder Bikes]]. Were active on both Hoth and Bespin.
*'''[[Wetland assault stormtrooper|Swamptrooper]]'''&mdash;Wetland Assault Stormtroopers, better known as Swamptroopers, were given tinted-green lightweight armor for camouflage in forested wetlands. Theywere often deployed near lakes, rivers, and other waterways where settlements tended to cluster on habitable planets. Their armor also incorporated environmental sealants to keep out several biological perils that thrive in swamplands, such as colonies of toxic bacteria, swarms of stinging insects, amphibious carnivores, and more.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]'''&mdash;Zero-G Assault Stormtroopers, better known as Spacetroopers, were widely considered the best soldiers in the galaxy, and specialized in assaulting and capturing starships. They served aboard vessels in the Imperial Navy, like the Imperial Marines, although they operated best in the interstellar void. Because of the nature of their job, their varying models of armor incorporated vacuum sealing and safeguards against hyperspatial radiation, as well as a propulsion system and a small arsenal of anti-starship weaponry.<ref name="IHB" />

In the [[Empire Reborn]] and the [[Dark Empire]] factions of the Galactic Empire, there were also stormtroopers that were trained as [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] called [[shadowtrooper]]s and [[darktrooper]]s,<ref name="Darktroopers">[[Dark Empire II 2|''Dark Empire II'' 2]] {{1stID|Darktrooper}}</ref> respectively (not to be confused with Cronal's unit of stormtroopers and/or the variant of the Imperial shock troopers, or the battle droids of the same name respectively). The latter's armor was indistinguishable from the stormtroopers save for a darker complexion, while the former had a significantly different set of armor, having a more cone-shaped helmet as well as a green center.<ref name="Dark Empire">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref><ref name="JediKnightII">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>

;Classified/experimental units
*'''[[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow stormtrooper]]'''&mdash;Shadow stormtroopers, also known as Blackhole Stormtroopers, were stormtroopers under the direct command of Agent Blackhole (the head of Imperial Intelligence), and as such their missions were considered extremely classified. However, they received special training in infiltration and ambush tactics.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Terror Trooper]]'''&mdash;Terror troopers were cyborg experiments conducted by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]]. Very rare, they specialized in direct combat with sharpened, durasteel talons on their hands and feet. Because of their cyborg limbs, they possessed enhanced strength, speed, and agility, and their masks also provide augmented respiration for their organic lungs. They also continued to fight even after the loss of one or more limbs.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Dark Trooper]]'''&mdash; Dark Troopers were battle droids specifically designed to bring back personal combat, and came in three phases, Phase I, Phase II, and Phase III.<ref name="IHB" /> Other models included [[Phase Zero dark trooper]]s, who were aged [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], transformed into cyborgs, and were essentially prototypes to the overall [[Dark Trooper Project]] that included the above three phases;<ref name="BF1">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> [[Triumphant-class dark trooper]], which were Dark troopers created as a hybrid between battle droids and stormtroopers; [[Black Hole dark trooper]]s, which were dark trooper models often deployed deployed with [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtroopers]]; [[Exogen-class dark trooper]]s; [[Dark Novatrooper|Dark novatrooper]]. which were dark trooper variants that were programmed with expertise in boarding operations; [[Glory-class dark trooper]], which were dark trooper variant that were primarily designed to function as [[City/Legends|city]] guards;<ref name="SW Galaxies" /> [[Inquisitorium dark trooper]]s, which were dark trooper variants created specifically to serve under the direct command of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]].<ref name="Trials of Obi-Wan">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref> and the [[purge trooper]], a dark trooper prototype specialized for anti-Jedi combat.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*'''[[Cuis clone]]'''&mdash;An experimental [[force-sensitive]] unit of [[clone stormtrooper]]s, they were created using the genetic template of the deceased [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sa Cuis]], and as such were trained to utilize lightsabers. However, although there were plans to create enough Cuis clones to form a battalion for deployment to the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]], this production line ended up terminated before it could enter mass-production after the six prototypes were involved in a coup instigated by their trainer, [[Sheyvan]], who was also an Emperor's Hand.<ref name="A Two-Edged Sword">{{InsiderCite|85|A Two-Edged Sword}}</ref>

;Elite Stormtrooper units
In addition, there were also several elite units within the Stormtrooper Corps, with their duties being directly tied to either defending the Emperor and the Imperial capital, or otherwise to steal technology to use against the Rebel Alliance.

*'''[[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]]'''&mdash;Considered the most important unit within the Imperial Military, the Emperor's Royal Guard was charged with the personal protection of the Galactic Emperor. They are hand-picked from within the ranks of the Stormtrooper Corps and are given extensive combat training at the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy]] on Yinchorr. Those who survive the training, including a battle to the death, are permitted to join the ranks. They are identified by their red robes, with matching armor inspired by the [[Sun Guard]].<ref name="IHB" />
**'''[[Emperor's Shadow Guard]]'''&mdash;A variant of the Emperor's Royal Guard, these guardsmen were trained to utilize the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark Side of the Force]]￼ and were considered an elite special operations unit within the Royal Guard. They are easily distinguishable from the Royal Guards by the inverted color patterns (i.e., the robes and underarmor are black, while the visor is red). They often wield lightsaber pikes into battle, though they did have access to heavy repeating pistols.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*'''[[Novatrooper]]'''&mdash;The novatroopers were stormtroopers who were selected for a place in the Emperor's honor guard. They are identified by armor glistening with black and gold ceremonial colors, and are rarely encountered outside of official Imperial ceremonies, including the semi-annual awarding of the Medal of Valor and the Emperor's public address at the start of New Year's Fete Week.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]'''&mdash;The Coruscant Guard maintained peace on Coruscant, and as such worked in conjunction with the Coruscant Police but outranked all local law officers in numbers. They maintained security at key governmental sites, including the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] and the [[Pliada di am Imperium]], and escorted high-ranking Imperial senators and moffs.<ref name="IHB" />
*'''[[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commando]]'''&mdash;Storm Commandos were the special forces division of the Stormtrooper Corps, formed specifically to beat the Rebel Alliance at their own game. Their armor is similar to that of scout troopers, albeit colored matte black, leading to the nickname of "shadow scouts". Their missions rely on stealth and have heavy emphasis on sabotage and assassination.<ref name="IHB" /><ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
*'''[[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Shock troopers]]'''&mdash;Similar to the Storm Commandos, the shock troopers acted as the special forces within the Stormtrooper Corps early into the Empire's existence. They acted under a support role, and as such had a variety of equipment to utilize, many of which are non-standard. They were easily distinguished from regular stormtroopers via their heavier armor.<ref name="TFUvg" />
**'''[[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Troopers''']]'''&mdash;A specialized version of the shock troopers, they were dispatched to various operations. They can be identified by their blue-lit panels underneath their armor.<ref name="TFUvg" />
***'''[[Shadow EVO Trooper]]'''&mdash;A variant of the EVO Troopers specifically under the command of the Shadow Troopers, they like the Shadow Troopers were dispatched to various operations. Their armor contained a personal cloaking device as well as advanced survival gear. These were extremely rare.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*'''[[Strategic Insertion battalion]]'''&mdash;Similar to the Storm Commandos, the Strategic Insertion battalion was a special forces unit within the Stormtrooper Corps that were deployed for infiltration and other operations against an enemy via the element of surprise. They were among the only Stormtrooper units where using their signature armor is not required.<ref name="SS">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>
*'''[[Imperial Elite Guard (Galactic Civil War)|Imperial Elite Guard]]'''&mdash;The Imperial Elite Guard were a unit of bodyguards tasked with guarding a Field Commander during military operations, in the event that an enemy force successfully infiltrated the compound the commander was staying at.<ref name="EaW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref><ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref> They were later [[Imperial Elite Guard|reorganized]] by [[41 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force">''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]''</ref>
*'''[[Vader's Special Force Trooper]]'''&mdash;[[Special forces/Legends|Special forces]] led by Lord Vader during the [[Occupation of Bespin]]. They wore similar uniforms to the Cold Assault Stormtroopers.
*'''[[Darth Vader's Security Force]]'''&mdash;An elite unit led by Lord Vader during the Occupation of Bespin. Like their counterparts, they wore similar uniforms to the Cold Assault Stormtroopers. However, their uniforms were colored red instead of the usual white. Some members also held similar equipment to the grenadier troopers, namely armored shields and plasma grenades.

;Related stormtroopers
Although technically not part of the Stormtrooper Corps due to their actually belonging to differing branches of the Imperial Military and in some cases actually not actually being affiliated with the Empire at all, these stormtroopers nonetheless had some ties to the Stormtrooper Corps in some way, whether it be due to joint cooperation with the stormtroopers, or otherwise being modeled after them for infiltration purposes by a third party.

*'''[[Stormtrooper droid]]'''&mdash;Stormtrooper droids were life-like droids encased in stormtrooper armor created on [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]] factories. They were not affiliated with the Empire at all, as they were instead created by [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] as part of their planned [[Droid Revolution|droid revolution]]. Their task was to kill a stormtrooper unit assigned to deliver a [[Computer core/Legends|computer core]] to the then-nearly finished [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] and replace them while also modifying the computer core to include [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A's]] consciousness.<ref name="Therefore I Am">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
*'''Trachta's Stormtroopers'''&mdash;These clone stormtroopers were not officially members of the Stormtrooper Corps, as they were created as part of a [[Anti-Sith conspiracy|conspiracy]] by various Imperial officers against the Emperor and Lord Vader due to the two potentates' ties to the [[Order of the Sith Lords]], headed by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Trachta]]. Several of these replaced the members of the Stormtroopers that were assigned to personally guard Palpatine after they were killed in a bombing of his shuttle. They were eventually wiped out when [[Kadir (Moff)|Kadir]], another member of the conspiracy, jumped the gun and arrogantly challenged Palpatine.<ref name="Empire: Betrayal" />
*'''[[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends#ISB stormtroopers|ISB stormtroopers]]'''&mdash;These stormtroopers were not actually part of the Stormtrooper Corps, or even the Imperial Military, answering instead to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. They were generally assigned to go undercover within various stormtrooper units in order to ensure the various members were ideologically consistent.<ref name="Allegiance" />
*'''[[Imperial Navy commando]]s'''&mdash;The Imperial Navy commandos technically answered to the Imperial Navy instead of the Stormtrooper Corps, but they wore similar armor and performed similar duties to various members of the Stormtrooper Corps and have been known to work alongside them.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*'''[[Imperial Senate Guard/Legends|Imperial Senate Guard]]'''&mdash;The Imperial Senate Guards were technically not part of the Stormtrooper Corps or even the standard Imperial Military hierarchy, officially acting as bodyguards for Imperial Senators. However, they wore similar attire to the Emperor's Royal Guard and have occasionally worked with the Stormtrooper Corps if the military operation was significant enough to require their presence.<ref name="TFUvg" />
**'''[[Imperial Senate Sentinel]]'''&mdash;Being a subdivision of the Imperial Senate Guards, the Imperial Senate Sentinels, like the senate guards, were technically not part of the Stormtrooper Corps or even the standard Imperial Military hierarchy. However, they did work alongside the Stormtrooper Corps if the mission was important enough to require their presence.<ref name="TFUvg" />
*'''[[Raptors]]'''&mdash;They weren't actually part of the Stormtrooper Corps, although they did play a similar role due to their being intended to act as replacements to the branch among Warlord [[Zsinj]]'s [[Zsinj's Empire|faction]].
*'''[[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army trooper]]'''&mdash;They weren't actually part of the Stormtrooper Corps, since they belong to the Imperial Army. However, some factions of the splintered Galactic Empire post-Battle of Endor did supply Imperial Army troopers with Stormtrooper armor to compensate for the loss of various Imperial Academies and/or cloning centers during their fight against the New Republic.
*'''[[Saber Guard]]s'''&mdash;They weren't actually aligned with the Stormtrooper Corps or even the standard Imperial Military, instead being [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] under the [[Saber Program]] that were personally trained by Lord Vader for Lightsaber combat. However, they have at times worked alongside members of the Stormtrooper Corps if their mission was important enough to require their presence.
**'''[[Imperial Sith Acolyte]]s'''&mdash;Like the Saber Guards, they weren't actually aligned with the Stormtrooper Corps or even the standard Imperial Military, instead being part of the Dark Side Adepts under the [[Acolyte Program]] that were personally trained by Lord Vader for Force combat. However, they have at times worked alongside members of the Stormtrooper Corps if their mission was deemed important enough to require their presence.
*'''[[TIE pilot]]'''s&ndash;They belonged to the Imperial Navy and thus were technically separate from the Stormtrooper Corps. However, they nevertheless wore similar attire especially regarding helmets, and there have been [[Unidentified Alderaanian stormtrooper|instances]] of TIE pilots also being members of the Stormtrooper Corps.<ref name="Alderaan factor" />

===Training===
{{Main|Imperial Academy/Legends}}
After the Stormtrooper Corps implemented a recruitment policy to replace the cloning stock, the program implemented a strict recruitment requirement for conformity standards to maintain the program's integrity as compensation for losing clones and constrain diverse and undirected human genetic stock. In particular, their genetic suitability compared to a human genome-type clone template needs to be 97.5% or higher, their height needed to be within 1.79-1.85 meters, their weight needed to be in the range of 78-85 kilograms, their body mass/musculature rating needed to have a Scala scoring of 22.x5 at maximum, their tactical intelligence rating needed a Marrev testing result of at least 790, and their receptivity to indoctrination's rating needs to have a minimum class of C. According to Nala Se, the resulting recruitment standards were such that they met the same minimum physical benchmarks as Kamino-grown clones, and the recruitment program was such that it allowed for interchangeable uniforms and armor as a bonus.<ref name="IHB" />

[[File:Cardia-Empire18.png|thumb|right|300px|Stormtroopers march through the Academy of Carida.]]
After passing recruitment standards, Stormtrooper recruits were deployed for training at one of the stormtrooper academies. At least two are known: The first, [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], was one of the more well-known facilities, which focused on training stormtrooper officers. As part of their training, the recruits at Carida undergo wilderness survival; desert warfare simulations; underwater battle tactics; experimental weapons testing; flash-memory instruction in military history; self-discipline through emotional suppression; and education in the principles of the Emperor's New Order.<ref name="IHB" /> In addition, the Stormtrooper training composed of both grueling physical tests (which were caused in part by the planet [[Carida]] having a stronger than average gravity field) as well as extensive indoctrination, which was strong enough to produce unswerving loyalty to the Empire, and leaving very few successful attempts to bribe, blackmail, or seduce them.<ref name="EG Warfare" />

Leia also noted that the indoctrination was extremely thorough to such an extent that they can't even be reasoned with, let alone deprogrammed, and as such, makes the ideology terrifying. In addition, this training was also credited as a large part of why the Stormtrooper Corps were victorious, in addition to their uniformity and ability to bring to bear overwhelming firepower. Their training was rigorous enough in its conditioning that Stormtroopers tended to favor their right side and adopt identical kneeling positions. It is also implied that, besides wilderness survival, desert warfare simulations, and underwater battle tactics, recruits to the Stormtrooper Corps also were extensively trained to survive in any environment, including those that harbored climates hostile to that of humans.<ref name="IHB" />

The second was the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy|Royal Guard Academy]] on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], which, befitting its unforgiving nature, was a very severe training facility. As indicated by the name, it primarily trained members of the Emperor's Royal Guard at the citadel, while smaller complexes trained other stormtrooper divisions, most notably those belonging to the Imperial riot troopers. The Royal Guard recruits are trained in various combat techniques as well as the art of Echani, with their practicing in the Squall arena. Their final test involved a battle to the death, which required the Emperor to personally oversee the test. Owing to the importance of the Yinchorr facility, it was kept top-secret, with even officers for the Empire with a high enough military rank to be allowed access to the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', the Imperial Military's field manual, not possessing the clearance level to know anything about the facility beyond generalities.<ref name="IHB" />

The Stormtrooper Corps, or at least those within the 501st Legion, were also known to be superb marksmen, with Obi-Wan Kenobi noting that they were extremely precise in their executing the Jawas on Tatooine. Leia also implied shortly after her escape from the Death Star that members of the Stormtrooper Corps generally don't miss their targets unless they were deliberately trying to lure their targets into a trap.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

In [[Unidentified Alderaanian stormtrooper|some cases]], the stormtroopers were also trained to fly TIE fighters.<ref name="Alderaan factor">[[Star Wars (1977) 86|''Star Wars'' (1977) 86]]</ref>

===Ranks===
{{Main|Rank insignia plaque/Legends}}
Like in the rest of the Imperial Military, officer ranks within the Stormtrooper Corps was denoted by a specific combination of colored squares and [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]] worn on the uniform.<ref name="EG Warfare" /><ref name="IHB" /> When out on the field, they generally also wear orange pauldrons and/or colored stripes on their armor. One of the few exceptions to this were the Cold Assault Stormtroopers, which wear rank insignia on the breastplate even while on the field.

==Equipment==
===Uniforms===
{{Main|Imperial military uniforms/Legends|Stormtrooper armor/Legends|Snowtrooper armor|Swamptrooper armor|Scout trooper armor|Seatrooper armor|Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark I|Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark II}}

The Stormtrooper Corps members had a variety of uniforms. Officers, when they aren't commissioned, wore a [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|black uniform]] with a double-breasted tunic, trousers, and a matching cap displaying an officer's disc. When commissioned, the stormtrooper officers instead wore variations of the stormtrooper armor denoting their rank. One variant, designated for [[field stormtrooper]] officers, just gave the armor markings of a stripe over the helmet, stripes over the right leg and feet, stripes across the chest in a Y-shaped pattern, stripes on the arms, and blue-color pauldrons, with the color representing the unit they held command over. The other variant, used on the field, had them wearing an orange shoulder paudron as well as bearing specific rank insignia.<ref name="IHB" />

Stormtrooper armor overall is composed of enclosed white armor over a black vacuum-sealed bodysuits. Variations, however, have existed depending on the nature of the training Stormtroopers have undergone, and to some extent the specific mission environment.

Freshly recruited Stormtroopers that, for obvious reasons, were rarely seen in direct combat, wore weaker armor than the more seasoned counterparts.<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

[[Assault trooper]]s utilized similar armor to the basic Stormtrooper armor, although it was given yellow highlights around the arms and helmet, giving them a slight similarity to the armor worn by Phase 1 clone trooper commanders. They were generally assigned to assault key Rebel Alliance bases, carry out head-on attacks, and were generally capable of fighting Rebel SpecForces when ambushed, and were frequently tasked with invading enemy planets and cities in full-scale.<ref name="SW Galaxies" />

[[Imperial Heavy Trooper/Legends|Imperial heavy troopers]], due to particular emphasis on hand-to-hand combat especially against larger aliens such as [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], wore a specialized form of Stormtrooper armor that was thick enough to withstand a lightsaber blow to some degree, and had a passing resemblance to Phase II clone armor, albeit with a slightly darker tone.<ref name="TFUvg" />

[[Armored Stormtrooper]]s wore a heavily armored version of the Stormtrooper armor, and also possessed orange pauldrons similar to the Imperial Marines, and their helmet included a red monocle device.<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" />

There are also cases where stormtroopers who had been specialized in a certain type of firearm were given a variation of their armor that included pauldrons with colors indicating their assigned tasks, such as yellow for [[Stormrifle|riflemen]] and blue/white for snipers. The latter also had slightly more durable armor.<ref name="SW Galaxies" /> In other cases, stormtroopers of a particular specialty don't have any major differences in terms of armor, like the [[Stormtrooper grenadier/Legends|Stormtrooper Grenadier]].<ref name="Assault Team">''[[Star Wars: Assault Team]]''</ref>

Although the Emperor's Royal Guard generally wore armor that resembled that of the Sun Guard, they have occasionally entered the field in crimson-colored stormtrooper armor.

In some cases, Stormtrooper armor was customized.<ref name="Custom armor card Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Custom Armor}}</ref>

===Weapons===
[[File:EmpireOnBackwaterPlanet-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Stormtrooper using an E-Web heavy repeating blaster]]
The standard rank-and-file members of the Stormtrooper Corps had as their standard weapon the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] and the [[SE-14r light repeating blaster/Legends|SE-14r light repeating blaster]],<ref name="IHB" /> the only exception being Stormtroopers who had been assigned to heavy and/or special weapons. Aside from these weapons, they also have at times been seen using weapons such as the [[4-X blaster rifle]], [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]], as well as the [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A blaster rifles]],<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blasters]],<ref name="ANH" /> [[T-28 repeating sniper rifle]]s, [[E-11s sniper rifle/Legends|E-11s sniper rifle]], [[Oppressor flamethrower]]s, [[Plasma caster]]s, [[ARC caster]]s,<ref name="Allegiance" /> and [[PLX-2M portable missile launcher]]s, [[PLX-4 Missile Launcher]]s, [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] projectile launchers, "[[Equalizer]]" shoulder ion-cannon, [[Ion mortar|Ion]] [[Mortar/Legends|mortars]], [[Stouker concussion rifle]], [[V-6d mortar launcher]]s, [[DXR6 heavy carbine]]s, [[Destructive Electromagnetic Pulse 2 ion carbine|DEMP 2]], [[Proton rifle/Legends|Proton rifles]], [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifles]], [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle]]s, [[Imperial Heavy Repeater]]s.<ref name="JediKnightII" /> They also had access to modified [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> The stormtroopers that served under the Empire Reborn faction of the Stormtrooper Corps were also known to have used [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] [[FC-1 flechette launcher/Legends|FC-1 flechette launchers]] or the [[FA-3 flechette launcher]]s.<ref name="Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> They also came equipped with [[Baradium-core code key thermal detonator]], which were attached to the back of the torso. In order to ensure an enemy doesn't use the detonator against the Stormtroopers if stolen, it requires a specific code that only the stormtrooper it was assigned to knows,<ref name="Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref><ref name="IHB" /> and the buttons are left unmarked to ensure the enemy can't input the code even if they did find out the code. Aside from the Baradium core detonators, they have also been known to use up to two [[LXR-6 concussion grenade/Legends|LXR-6 concussion grenades]].<ref name="BF1" />

Some stormtroopers also had their own armory for their assigned roles. [[Stormtrooper sniper/Legends|Stormsnipers]], for example, utilized the [[RT-97C heavy blaster rifle/Legends|RT-97C heavy blaster rifle]].<ref name="Assault Team" />

Although stormtroopers did not utilize lightsabers, the Cuis clones did utilize lightsabers due to their being force-sensitive as a result of being cloned from the deceased Emperor's Hand Sa Cuis.<ref name="A Two-Edged Sword" />

In addition, stormtroopers were also trained to operate [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web Heavy Repeating Blasters]] or [[E-Web missile launcher|E-Web Missile Launchers]].<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" />

===Vehicles and steeds===
The Stormtrooper Corps, aside from the vehicles assigned to them during joint missions with either the Imperial Army or the Imperial Navy, also had access to some of their own vehicles, such as the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]],<ref name="TF">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref> the [[Imperial escort carrier (storm commando)|Imperial escort carriers]] and [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE/HU Hunter multi-role starfighters]] used by the Storm Commandos,<ref name="IHB" /><ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> as well as the [[Emperor's Royal Guard TIE/IN starfighter|Emperor's Royal Guard TIE/In starfighter]] for members of the Emperor's Royal Guard.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> During the early stages of the Empire, when stationed on former Separatist worlds, the Stormtrooper Corps would make use of battle droids such as the [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]], ironically enough to help clear the remaining Separatist hold-outs in the early stages of the Empire. Even afterwards, they often had them near checkpoints.

In addition, they have also utilized [[Dewback/Legends|Dewback]] lizards as steeds when conducting ground operations. These stormtroopers, known as [[Dewback trooper/Legends|Dewback troopers]], often used them to attack mechanized weaponry such as Rebel combat speeders and Rebel attack tanks<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" /> as well as patrols,<ref name="Characters">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> though they were also suited for taking down troop centers. Although they were most suitable for desert areas due to their reptilian nature and thus were mostly part of the desert stormtroopers, they were also observed being used even in areas such as Hoth.<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StormtroopersInAction.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A deleted scene of stormtroopers in action from [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].]]
According to Mary S. Henderson's ''Star Wars: The Magic of Myth'', the stormtroopers, and in particular, their armor, were partly inspired by the police droids of the underground prison facility in [[Wikipedia:THX-1138|THX-1138]], one of George Lucas's first films.<ref name="Star Wars: The Magic of Myth book">[[Star Wars: The Magic of Myth (book)|''Star Wars: The Magic of Myth'']]</ref>
